**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

- **Scanned:** § 2 (LICENSE), § 8 (Client covenants), § 7, § 10, § 12, plus targeted searches for "compet*", "Client shall not / will not / may not", "exclusive/exclusivity/field of use/territory/restrict", and "develop/engage/business of".
- **No restrictive covenant binds Client.** § 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom: Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," limited only by TrueLink's IP rights and our § 10 confidentiality obligations.
- **Not a field-of-use restriction:** the "ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables" wording scopes the licence granted *to us*, and is not a covenant about what businesses we may operate or products we may build/buy.
- **Noted, not flagged:** § 8(d) refers to an undefined "Non-Competition Agreement," but there it limits *TrueLink's* licence to use Credit Data (i.e., it benefits us). Worth diligencing that separate document for any covenant binding Client, but nothing in this Agreement restricts our business.
